description: The bar chart illustrates correlations between ChatGPT’s QA performance and four popularity-related measures derived from ground-truth versus generated answers, shown as Pop\_GT, Pop\_Ge, RPop\_GT, and RPop\_Ge across three domains. The horizontal axis contains the categorical groups Movies, Songs, and Basketball (left to right), and the vertical axis is labeled “Correlation” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.7 and regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Within each category, four adjacent bars are displayed: Pop\_GT is a solid light-orange bar (Movies ≈ 0.22, Songs ≈ 0.30, Basketball ≈ 0.07), Pop\_Ge is a light-orange bar with diagonal hatching (Movies ≈ 0.10, Songs ≈ 0.09, Basketball ≈ 0.09), RPop\_GT is a solid blue bar (Movies ≈ 0.35, Songs ≈ 0.49, Basketball ≈ 0.13), and RPop\_Ge is a blue bar with diagonal hatching (Movies ≈ 0.64, Songs ≈ 0.70, Basketball ≈ 0.20). The bars are grouped by domain with consistent color/texture encoding indicated by the legend in the upper-right, there is no stacking, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the use of solid versus hatched fills.
